text: The one breaking change this week is #13326, which makes five test-only IsHandled events in Fabric Platform Mgt internal, renames the Fabric mirroring app, removes the unused Key Vault client-ID lookup and moves telemetry to real audit logs; #12557 adds first-party authentication to the same app. Posting fixes dominate the rest: #13458 corrects ACY on entries moved between receivables accounts, #13415 fixes reverse charge VAT with 100% non-deductible VAT in foreign currency, #13248 and #12474 send the non-deductible reverse-charge correction to the payment discount account, and #13216 fixes the VAT adjustment register. Localization fixes cover GST in #13342, #13334 and #12979, FatturaPA file names in #12292, French payment slips in #13134 and Norwegian SAF-T totals in #12696. Subscription Billing gets #12796, #12519 and #12998, while #12996 lets Item Reclassification Journals post with zero CO2e. Hangs and failures are fixed in vendor remittance export (#13294, #13255) and in the WIP transfer shipment Bin Code check (#13293, #13166). Agent work includes Expense Agent corporate cards (#12147) and consumption V2 with a trial (#12539), plus Sales Order Agent changes such as #12821. #13303 lets Bank Reconciliation with Copilot switch models by configuration. Extensibility additions are #10992, #13111 and #13261, and #13262 speeds up the Trial Balance by Period Excel report with a query.

issues: "Posting fixes dominate the rest" is a judgement. Some notable fixes are left out, such as the average cost adjustment overflow (#13220) and the Reminder and Finance Charge Memo printing fix (#13159).
#13261 is listed with the extensibility additions, which is correct. Its summary does not say which extension points were added, and the paragraph does not claim any.
